mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% in a month signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate investments, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances when the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% in a month indicates a weakening labor market, which signals a potential economic slowdown and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances when the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP by more than 2% quarter-over-quarter signals strong economic growth, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the quarters when the GDP growth exceeds 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production by more than 1% month-over-month signals a contraction in supply, which can lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as it indicates a potential economic slowdown.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances when the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts by more than 5% month-over-month signals a strengthening demand for housing, which is a leading indicator of economic growth and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances when the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in nonfarm payrolls by more than 100,000 in a month signals a weakening labor market, which can lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as it indicates a potential economic slowdown.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances when the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is above 4% and CPI inflation is rising, it indicates a tightening monetary policy with high inflation, which increases borrowing costs and reduces consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances when both trigger conditions are met.

mechanism_narrative: When real GDP growth is positive and housing starts are increasing, it signals a strong economic demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 30% of the instances when both trigger conditions are met.
